integrity: Source equations and earlier RC charging results are credited; analytic proof supports all infinite-parameter claims; deterministic diagnostics are not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Small-housekeeping uniqueness at finite affinity is not extended to all cost ratios

title: A logarithmic housekeeping clock for active-matter battery charging
